sentences.en: Glacial meltwater is not purer than other types of water.
sentences.zh: 冰川融水并不比其他类型的水更纯净。

sentences.en: Glacial water gets its colour from rock flour.
sentences.zh: 冰川水的颜色来自岩石粉。

sentences.en: There are three glacial fjords in Ireland.
sentences.zh: 爱尔兰有三个冰蚀峡湾。

senses.zh: 冰期的，冰川期的；寒冷的，冰冷的；冷若冰霜的
